build_package_setup: build a python setup.py package with name, version, description, and install_requires from requirements.txt
create_function_load_requirements: create a function that parses a requirements.txt file using pip parse_requirements and returns a list of requirement strings
run_package_install: run pip install on the SiLK Keypoint Library package with all dependencies from requirements.txt
review_setup_config: review the python setup.py configuration including name, version, author, packages, and install_requires fields
test_requirements_parsing: test the load_requirements function parses requirements.txt and returns a list of pip requirement strings
